video.title: I am invited for Grafana Conference in USA! GrafanaCon 2025 Agenda

transcript.text: Guys, I am invited to attend Grafana
2025 in Seattle. So, what is Grafana,
you might ask? Graphana is Grafana Lab's
annual flagship community event. And
this time, it's happening in person from
May 6th to May 8th in Seattle. So, if
you are a DevOps engineer, developer, S,
or someone who loves open source, this
is your chance to learn everything about
observability, connect with brilliant
minds, and explore the future of
metrics, logs, and traces. Registration
for Grafana is open and if you're
willing to attend, you can use my coupon
code cloud champ 2025 for an extra 20%
discount. All right, so what's happening
in Grafana? This year, Grafana's lineup
is absolutely packed from exciting
product launches and deep dive technical
sessions to new formats like science
fair, birds of feather group and a
special party at Museum of Pop Culture.
So, in this video, I'll walk you through
the highlights of Grafana agenda and
tell you what I am mostly excited about
and why you should consider attending
Grafana. Let's go. Grafana is a 3 days
